description: This file defines the 'Dish' result class for the Coocook schema, representing dishes in a database. It includes column definitions, relationships to other entities like meals and recipes, and methods for recalculating ingredient quantities and deleting associated records.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::Dish
classes.description: A class representing the 'dishes' table in the database, with relationships to meals, recipes, ingredients, and tags, and methods for recalculating ingredient quantities and cleanup.

methods.name: recalculate
methods.description: Recalculates ingredient quantities based on a new number of servings and updates related items.

methods.name: update_items_and_delete
methods.description: Removes ingredients from purchase list, deletes ingredients, and deletes the dish itself.

methods.name: for_meals_dishes_editor
methods.description: Returns a hashref with dish data and associated meal date for editing purposes.
